name: PayHero
description:
The PayHero connector lets your AI assistant answer questions about your PayHero payroll data in a conversation.

You can ask about employees and their roles, leave balances and requests, pay totals, and hours worked. For example, "how much annual leave does Sarah have left?" or "what were total wages last month?" and get an answer from your
live PayHero data.

It's read-only, the assistant can look information up, but can't create, change, or delete anything in PayHero.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PayHero to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PayHero to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://publicapi.payhero.co.nz/payhero-public-api-mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PayHero MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PayHero provides these MCP tools: getEmployeeLeaveBalances, getEmployeeProfile, getHoursSummary, getLeave, getLeaveSummary, getPaySummary, and getLeaveLiability.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PayHero?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PayHero in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
PayHero requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PayHero is developed by FlexiTime. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
